name: Mage-tastic Gizmonitor
label: Quest
description: Mage-tastic Gizmonitor: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We mages do more than just waggle our fingers and make pretty sparks! We control magic, the base fabric of our world! And that takes great care, and resolve. And knowledge... So much knowledge!

One of my devices, the mage-tastic gizmonitor, collects and stores that knowledge in huge amounts! But it's lost! When we fled our home of Gnomeregan, I left it in a chest in one of our huts outside the city, and now the place is crawling with leper gnomes!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you find the gizmonitor? I must have it before its energy supply runs out!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, splendid day! When I made the gizmonitor I never realized how dependent on it I would become. Now I can begin my studies anew!
Thank you, friend! And here--these were my first tools as a mage. They're a little scratched but they're well tested. Take your pick--I'm sure you'll find either of them useful.
